annotations.title: mlpeek: extract named entities from text

description: mlpeek: Extract named entities: people, organisations, places, dates, money, ... For fields of your own schema use extract_json_with_schema. Returns named entities in English text with spaCy en_core_web_sm 3.8.0 (MIT): text, label (the 18 OntoNotes types: PERSON, ORG, GPE, LOC, DATE, MONEY, ...) and code-point offsets (end exclusive), plus counts per label; at most 2,000 entities (then `entities_truncated`). A statistical model: it can miss or mislabel entities. English only. Runs an open model pinned by hash on Tanod's own CPU (no LLM, no third-party API); an unavailable model is a 503 (not charged). Typically under 0.1 s for 2,000 characters, under 0.5 s at 20,000. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 5 mlpeek calls per IP per UTC day. The submitted text is never logged or stored. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/named-entity-recognition-zero-shot-classification-api.html
